purpose: Frozen SCAFFOLD and matched SGD controls at predeclared benign false-alert targets; training-only diagnostic, not retraining or a replacement for the failed prior screen
split: SHA256(domain || canonical little-endian float32 full39 feature bytes), first byte <128 for calibration, otherwise audit. Normalize signed zero. Group exact model-input duplicates, including conflicting labels. Labels and model scores never affect membership. Approximately half, not exact stratification. Stop if either partition misses a class; do not retry a seed
partition_limitation: Both groups were used during model fitting; audit is held out ONLY from threshold fitting. No unseen-traffic, near-duplicate, source-session independence or population FAR guarantee
decision: score = highest attack logit minus benign logit, subtracted in float64 from FP32 logits. Attack iff score > threshold, else Benign. Attack class is always its highest logit with canonical-order ties. No probability calibration, model fitting, new classifier or attack re-ranking
threshold: Use ONLY benign calibration scores. k=floor(n*target_basis_points/10000). Threshold is ascending order statistic n-k-1 (zero based); strict > excludes ties and permits at most k empirical calibration false alerts. Report achieved calibration AND audit FAR; equal target is not exact equal audit FAR
report: Every target for every arm, all8 recalls/precisions/F1/confusion, binary attack alarm recall separate from correct category recall, and per-attack recall ceiling if benign rejection is entirely removed. No favorable target or model chosen after scoring
bridges: Zero threshold must exactly match argmax and full-training argmax confusion/metrics must equal the frozen historical receipt. Stop on mismatch. Verify saved model tensor hashes and unchanged source bytes
interpretation: At primary5%, only if SCAFFOLD gains >=1pp macro-F1 over FedAvg with neither rare recall declining, absolute audit FAR difference <=0.5pp, and each achieved audit FAR within0.5pp of target, permit separately planned from-scratch paired-seed development. Otherwise stop this continuation. Secondary1%/10% are descriptive, not alternative routes to a pass. Previous training screen stays failed regardless. No automatic training follows
stopping: One frozen threshold per arm per declared target; no new targets, model edits or hyperparameter retries after observing audit results
deployment_limitation: Offline simulator uses pooled benign calibration scores; a real federated calibration protocol and its privacy/communication costs are not implemented or claimed
